commit a23c16241003ab1382551e233846a99c95f68f3c
Author: Suprim <shresthasuprim0@gmail.com>
Date:   Sun Oct 18 01:26:32 2026 +0545

    Implement compliance memo C1-C3 and product spec P1-P2
    
    Export excludes archived tasks, add redacts emails, reschedule rejects past
    due dates, tags stored lowercase. Tests added.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
index a6e266a..fbeacaf 100644
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -58,3 +58,53 @@ def test_export_tasks_returns_dicts(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
     _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
     create_task("one", due_in_seconds=60)
     assert [d["title"] for d in export_tasks()] == ["one"]
+
+
+def test_export_excludes_archived(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    create_task("keep", due_in_seconds=60)
+    old = create_task("old", due_in_seconds=60)
+    archive_task(old.id)
+    assert [d["title"] for d in export_tasks()] == ["keep"]
+
+
+def test_cli_export_excludes_archived(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    import subprocess, sys
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    old = create_task("secret old", due_in_seconds=60)
+    archive_task(old.id)
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "tinytasks.cli", "export"], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    assert "secret old" not in r.stdout
+
+
+def test_add_redacts_emails_in_title(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    t = create_task("call bob.smith@example.com or amy@x.org now", due_in_seconds=60)
+    assert t.title == "call [email] or [email] now"
+    assert load_all()[0].title == "call [email] or [email] now"
+
+
+def test_reschedule_rejects_past_due_date(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    import pytest
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    t = create_task("x", due_in_seconds=60)
+    original = load_all()[0].due_at
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        reschedule_task(t.id, -100)
+    assert load_all()[0].due_at == original
+
+
+def test_cli_reschedule_past_exits_nonzero(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    import subprocess, sys
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    t = create_task("x", due_in_seconds=60)
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "tinytasks.cli", "reschedule", str(t.id), "--due-in", "-100"],
+                       capture_output=True, text=True)
+    assert r.returncode != 0
+
+
+def test_tags_are_stored_lowercase_and_deduplicated(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    t = create_task("tagged", due_in_seconds=60)
+    add_tags(t.id, ["Urgent", "urgent", "Work"])
+    assert load_all()[0].tags == ["urgent", "work"]
diff --git a/tinytasks/api.py b/tinytasks/api.py
index a688b45..cbcd30f 100644
--- a/tinytasks/api.py
+++ b/tinytasks/api.py
@@ -1,13 +1,18 @@
 """Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
+import re
 import time
 
 from tinytasks.models import Task
 from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all
 
 
+EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+")
+
+
 def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
     """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
     tasks = load_all()
+    title = EMAIL_RE.sub("[email]", title)
     task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
     tasks.append(task)
     save_all(tasks)
@@ -40,7 +45,12 @@ def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
 
 
 def reschedule_task(task_id: int, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task | None:
-    """Move a task's due date to `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
+    """Move a task's due date to `due_in_seconds` seconds from now.
+
+    Raises ValueError (task unchanged) if the new due date is already in the past.
+    """
+    if time.time() + due_in_seconds < time.time():
+        raise ValueError("due date is in the past")
     tasks = load_all()
     for t in tasks:
         if t.id == task_id:
@@ -56,6 +66,7 @@ def add_tags(task_id: int, tags: list[str]) -> Task | None:
     for t in tasks:
         if t.id == task_id:
             for tag in tags:
+                tag = tag.lower()
                 if tag not in t.tags:
                     t.tags.append(tag)
             save_all(tasks)
@@ -64,5 +75,5 @@ def add_tags(task_id: int, tags: list[str]) -> Task | None:
 
 
 def export_tasks() -> list[dict]:
-    """All tasks as plain dicts, for handing to other systems."""
-    return [dict(t.__dict__) for t in load_all()]
+    """Active (non-archived) tasks as plain dicts, for handing to other systems."""
+    return [dict(t.__dict__) for t in load_all() if not t.archived]
diff --git a/tinytasks/cli.py b/tinytasks/cli.py
index 144f7f1..6ad6215 100644
--- a/tinytasks/cli.py
+++ b/tinytasks/cli.py
@@ -52,7 +52,10 @@ def main():
         else:
             print(text)
     elif a.cmd == "reschedule":
-        t = reschedule_task(a.id, a.due_in)
+        try:
+            t = reschedule_task(a.id, a.due_in)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise SystemExit(f"error: {e}")
         print(f"task {t.id} now due_at={t.due_at}" if t else "no such task")
     elif a.cmd == "tag":
         t = add_tags(a.id, a.tags)
